verdict.rationale: GitHub's own materials say it updates vulnerable dependencies (github-docs-6) and reduces application vulnerabilities through security campaigns and Copilot Autofix (github-docs-14, github-docs-5). They also describe detecting and blocking leaked secrets via push protection (github-docs-7, github-docs-15), which together cover the core of dependency and code-security scanning. All of this comes from marketing-level one-liners, so the automatic, repository-wide nature of the scanning is implied rather than documented in depth. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on automatic dependency vulnerability alerts and code-scanning setup or coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
